annotations.text:
Four ways to group Search, Ask, Saved lists, Area alerts, Pre-planning and a new My Account.

Read left to right: where we are today, then four directions, each pulling on a different axis. Pick one and I'll build it out properly.

My pick: Option B.

The move that matters most is in B, C and D — Ask stops being a peer of Search and becomes a layer over whatever you're looking at. B is the smallest structure that gets every feature visible and gives the pre-planning report full width.

Option C is where B goes if the personal side keeps growing.

Whichever we pick, two things need deciding:

1. Does leaving Search keep the map's position and filters? Today the map stays mounted behind the dashboard — that should hold for every destination.

2. Where does drawing an area alert happen? It needs the map, so it can't be a screen that leaves it.
